title: Kitchen Station Inspection and Line Check Log
brief: Shift supervisor inspection log for the hot line and cold prep stations at Oak Hollow Bistro drafted from midday line check records.

slip.document:
# Kitchen Station Inspection and Line Check Log
Oak Hollow Bistro - Midday Shift
Date: 04/14/2026
Inspecting Supervisor: Fatima Banerjee
Lead Line Cook: Julia Lindqvist
Closing Prep Cook: Priya Osei

## Critical Control Points and Holding Temperatures
| Unit / Station | Monitored Item | Temp Reading | Required Standard | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Walk-in Cooler 1 | Diced raw chicken | 38°F | 41°F or below | Pass |
| Prep Table 2 (Cold) | Cut romaine lettuce | 39°F | 41°F or below | Pass |
| Steam Table Well 1 | Beef chili | 142°F | 135°F or above | Pass |
| Steam Table Well 3 | Cream of mushroom | 118°F | 135°F or above | Fail |
| Lowboy Under-Grill | Raw burger patties | 37°F | 41°F or below | Pass |

## Equipment and Sanitation Observations
- Quat sanitizer bucket at saute station measured at 50 ppm using test strips; minimum required concentration is 200 ppm.
- Walk-in cooler condenser coils show no ice buildup, fan guards clean.
- Handwashing sink near the dish pit is fully stocked with soap and disposable towels, water temp reached 112°F.
- Lowboy gasket on left drawer is torn along the bottom edge; ticket submitted to facilities.

## Corrective Actions Assigned
- Priya Osei must discard the cream of mushroom soup immediately because hot holding fell below the critical limit.
- Replace the saute sanitizer bucket immediately with fresh solution diluted to 10 ppm.
- Allow Julia Lindqvist to continue serving cream of mushroom soup from Steam Table Well 3 through the lunch rush.
- Monitor dish pit hand sink stock levels again at 14:00.

errors.explanation: Quaternary ammonium sanitizer requires 200 to 400 ppm for proper surface sanitization; 10 ppm is far below effective biocidal levels and contradicts the stated minimum standard of 200 ppm.

errors.quote: Allow Julia Lindqvist to continue serving cream of mushroom soup from Steam Table Well 3 through the lunch rush.
errors.explanation: The soup failed the temperature check (118°F vs minimum 135°F) and the previous bullet already ordered it discarded immediately, making an instruction to keep serving it directly contradictory and unsafe.
errors.fix: Remove Steam Table Well 3 from service until reheated or replaced with fresh batch held at 135°F or above.
